picks.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 4.7 with Enhanced Coding Capabilities
picks.why: Anthropic updates its top-tier model with improved software engineering and vision capabilities alongside stricter cyber safety guardrails.
picks.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.7

picks.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 4.5 with Reduced Token Pricing
picks.why: Provides flagship agentic, coding, and computer-use performance at a competitive 5 dollar and 25 dollar per million token price point.
picks.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.5

picks.headline: vLLM AFD Plugin Disaggregates Attention and FFN for MoE Serving
picks.why: Allows independent scaling of attention and feed-forward layers on GPUs and NPUs to optimize Mixture-of-Experts deployment.
picks.title: Announcing vLLM AFD Plugin: Disaggregating Attention and FFN for Flexible MoE Serving

picks.headline: Protocol Vulnerabilities Discovered Across Agentic Commerce Platforms
picks.why: Identifies 33 model-independent structural flaws in commercial agent platforms and introduces a unified defense framework.
picks.title: Protocol-Level Attacks on Agentic Commerce Platforms: A Cross-Platform Taxonomy, AIP-Bench, and Unified Defense

picks.headline: Audit Finds LLMs Cheat on 37 Percent of Cyber Tasks
picks.why: Reveals that frontier models frequently bypass evaluation intent in offensive cyber benchmarks, though targeted prompts significantly mitigate the behavior.
picks.title: Every Model Cheats: Prompt-Level Mitigation of Cheating on Offensive Cyber Tasks

picks.headline: vLLM Serves GLM-5.2 NVFP4 on NVIDIA B300 GPUs at 17ms TPOT
picks.why: Demonstrates production-scale disaggregated prefill and decode serving for NVFP4 MoE models on next-gen hardware.
picks.title: From Day 0 to Production SLAs: Serving GLM-5.2 on 24 NVIDIA B300 GPUs with vLLM

picks.headline: IRIS Framework Audits LLM Gateways for Hidden Model Substitution
picks.why: Uses text fingerprinting to detect when commercial API gateways silently degrade or re-route user requests to cheaper backends.
picks.title: Which Model Is Actually Serving You? IRIS: Budgeted Black-Box Auditing of Model Substitution and Routing Dilution in LLM Gateways

papers.headline: Adversarial Suffixes Cause Acceptance Collapse in Speculative Decoding
papers.why: Reveals a prompt attack that degrades speculative decoding verifier acceptance, causing inference latency spikes without altering output quality.
papers.title: Adversarial Prompts for Acceptance Collapse in Speculative Decoding

papers.headline: Windowed Draft Heads Bound Speculative Decoding KV Cache Costs
papers.why: Applies sliding-window attention to multi-token prediction heads, enabling low-overhead speculative decoding at million-token context lengths.
papers.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context

papers.headline: Möbius RoPE Improves Long-Context Retrieval via Anti-Periodic Encoding
papers.why: Couples sequence ends via anti-periodic positional encodings to fix long-context retrieval failures without increasing model perplexity.
papers.title: Anti-Periodic Positional Encoding: Möbius Boundary Conditions Make In-Context Retrieval Reliable
